items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I noticed you also included in that selection a Noel Coward song. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: course, all I had to do was sing the melody. They were doing all the strange things behind me. I did what I was -- But it was sort of strange hearing the different changes that I hadn't been used to.
I noticed you also included in that selection a Noel Coward song.
